# Jeremiah 25 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah — that was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon —

**2** The LORD declared concerning seventy years of captivity through the prophet Jeremiah in those days.

**3** The LORD declared concerning seventy years of captivity through the prophet Jeremiah in those days.

**8** The LORD declared concerning seventy years of captivity through the prophet Jeremiah in those days.

**9** Behold, I will send for all the tribes of the north, declares the LORD, and for Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant, and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants, and against all these surrounding nations. I will devote them to destruction, and make them a horror, a hissing, and an everlasting desolation.

**10** The LORD declared concerning seventy years of captivity through the prophet Jeremiah in those days.

**11** This whole land shall become a ruin and a waste, and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

**12** Then after seventy years are completed, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their iniquity, declares the LORD, making the land an everlasting waste.

**13** The LORD declared concerning seventy years of captivity through the prophet Jeremiah in those days.

**14** The LORD declared concerning seventy years of captivity through the prophet Jeremiah in those days.

**15** For thus the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: "Take from My hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

- **25:1**: The seventy years of captivity oracle opens with the standard prophetic commissioning formula.

- **25:19**: The cup of wrath imagery connects to Jeremiah's theology of exile as divine discipline and future restoration.

- **25:38**: The chapter closes with the divine declaration formula, affirming the certainty of the prophetic word.

— LOGOS
